Important for home backup

These are portable power stations, not necessarily whole-home backup systems. Their output ratings don't mean they can power every household circuit simultaneously. A fridge, Wi-Fi router, lights and device chargers are realistic essentials; central air conditioning, electric water heaters and well pumps may require more power or specialized wiring.

My recommendation: Choose the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 if you find it for $899 or less. If you want to add battery capacity later, choose the Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 instead.
